preservation: Never mutate production deployment, authorization, Core/Account state or any learner database in Phase 01.
Do not delete, clear, import or rewrite IndexedDB, browser localStorage, review histories, private content, sync outboxes or service workers.
Maintain original content identifiers, source rights, attribution, language varieties and versioned vocabulary source references.
Do not synthesize StudyEvents, memoryReview grades, FSRS traces, confidence, CEFR/HSK/JLPT equivalence, or official proficiency labels.
Treat old applications as current write authorities until an explicit, validated per-language cutover with reversible backup.
Treat source snapshot SHAs as observations from 2026-10-22, not claims of current deployment or continuous source drift validation.
Keep Hub projections read-only and distinct from learner event and enrollment write authorities.
Never equate an accepted prompt structure or speech transcript with human-validated pronunciation/production.
Source-restricted lessons and private learner assets cannot be copied into public packages without verified redistribution permission.
Every future learner migration requires an explicitly approved, idempotent and reversible import with loss and conflict reporting; no silent cross-origin transfer.
